result:
Lane fleetreg is done. PR #133 is ready, mergeable, labelled.

**Why attempt 1 didn't finish** (now recorded at the top of `docs/lanes/fleetreg/NOTES.md`): the work and the PR body were complete, but the PR was never taken out of draft — so the fold job, which only considers non-draft PRs, could not see it. The same failure mode as the defect it fixes, one level up: a result nobody can read is not a result.

**What attempt 2 did:**

- Merged `origin/master` **twice**. Master moved again between the first merge and the push; local preflight was green while GitHub reported `CONFLICTING`, so the second merge came from re-reading the PR's `mergeable` field rather than trusting one fetch. Both conflicts were in `selftest.sh` between independent blocks; both kept master's block ahead of this lane's, so this one stays immediately before the summary. Verified additive rather than merely syntactically clean — `git diff origin/master -- docs/testing/jobs/selftest.sh | grep -c '^-[^-]'` is **0**, so no line of master's was dropped in either resolution.
- Moved `NOTES.md` from the retired branch-root path to `docs/lanes/fleetreg/NOTES.md`.
- Gate: **112 passed, 0 failed**. Falsification re-run post-merge: **new 26/0, old 5 passed / 21 failed**. Master touched neither `fleet.py` nor `lane.sh` across all ten commits, so "old" is still exactly the code this PR replaces — the split still measures something.
- `preflight.sh --allow-tracker` passes; `Files:` on the PR body matches `git diff --stat origin/master...HEAD` (four paths, including the new NOTES location); `gh pr ready 133`; `gh-label.sh add 133 harness`.

Body edits went through `gh api -X PATCH` and were read back, since `gh pr edit` fails on this host for every flag, not just `--add-label`.

Two things I found but did not fix, both outside my four files and both flagged rather than edited:

- `check_coverage.py:fleet_tail()` has the same defect this PR closes, and feeds the idle-watchdog's only live advice channel. Already a `[lane.fleetreg]` comment on #133; this PR makes the two-line fix importable via `from fleet import lane_units`.
- Master's fold of #129 landed a root `NOTES.md` again (lane.blit84's), with no `docs/lanes/blit84/` — the exact collision `1f7572a34c` added `fold.sh resolve-notes` to prevent, so either that fold predates the resolver or it did not fire. The next lane to land notes will conflict on the root path as before.
